metadata.article_title: Penalty for failure to comply with the provisions of section 397.

article.title: Penalty for failure to comply with the provisions of section 397.
article.content:
468Penalty for failure to comply with the provisions of section 397.

Section 468  ·  Chapter XXI  ·  page 554 of the Act
(1) If a person fails to comply with the provisions of section 397, the Assessing Officer may impose a penalty of Rs. 10000 on him.
(2) If a person, required to quote his Tax Deduction and Collection Account Number in challans, certificates, statements or other documents referred to in section 397(1)(b), quotes a number which is false, knowing or believing it to be false or not true, the Assessing Officer may impose a penalty of Rs. 10000 on him.
